Riya Patel: quick flag — Arbora Connect onboarding showing p95 spikes ~2.6s during nightly batch window and token spend tracking ~2.4x forecast. Renewal in ~40 days. Propose a proactive pilot: mixed INT8 quant + adaptive-batching and targeted tail routing to their dedicated us-east pool. Need eng + SRE + enablement to sign-off on a 72h canary.

Marco Li: can you paste the perf dash and an example trace?

Riya Patel: dash: https://redwood.app/d/arbora/connect-ops?panelId=tailing
trace: `req=arb-421 seq=1..1024 p50=140ms p95=2.6s model=redwood/osiris-13b`

Marco Li: initial plan — try `osiris-13b-int8` with adaptive batching (batch window=10ms, max_batch_tokens=4096) + route requests with seq_len > 512 to dedicated pool with sample rate 0.15 for canary. Expect token-cost ~38% lower and smoother scheduling.

Riya Patel: dropping canary config below and cc @Casey for enablement timing.

Marco Li: ```
# canary config: adaptive batching + tail routing + quantized model
{
  "selector": "customer_id == \"arbora\" && random() < 0.12",
  "model": "redwood/osiris-13b-int8",
  "pool": "dedicated-arbora-us-east",
  "adaptive_batching": {"enabled": true, "window_ms": 10, "max_batch_tokens": 4096},
  "route": {"condition": "seq_len > 512", "sample_rate": 0.15},
  "max_concurrency": 90,
  "fallback": "redwood/osiris-13b",
  "monitoring": {"slo_p95_ms": 1400, "compare_against": "osiris-13b"}
}
```

Casey Tran: I can run a 60-min enablement: 15m infra, 20m canary ops, 15m customer playbook. Available Mon/Wed next week.

Noor Ahmed: I'll check pool headroom. Any estimates for expected peak rps? Also need IAM list.

Marco Li: expected steady qps ~160, spikes ~420. IAM: riya@redwood, marco@redwood, casey@redwood. Marco: rough cost delta calc -> baseline unit ~$0.019/token-eq; int8 path ~38% lower => ~$0.0118/token-eq. For their 3.2B monthly tokens that's ~ $34k/mo savings estimate. Will refine post-canary.

PerfBot: [alert] arbora_prod_avg_seq_len increased 27% in 48h; token_rate +20%. Ticket CS-2782 created.

Harper SRE: I can reserve a 2-GPU slot in dedicated-arbora-us-east for a 72h canary. I'll attach temporary relabeling so telemetry splits properly. Need expected peak rps and IAM (see above).

Riya Patel: great — I'll draft the customer-facing note focusing on tail smoothing, cost delta, and success criteria (p95 reduction, cost delta within 15% of forecast, error parity). Sharing for review before sending.

Casey Tran: please include rollback criteria and the exec summary for the renewal doc. I'll slot the enablement once Harper confirms reservation.

Marco Li: will prepare smoke tests and a short eval harness to compare generation quality (BLEU-like metrics + a small human review set) between int8 and baseline.

Riya Patel: thanks team — aiming to kick the canary next Tue. Will update thread when reservation is done :rocket:
